newsitem.title: FRANCE: France may sell 25-35 pct of France Telecom.
newsitem.headline: France may sell 25-35 pct of France Telecom.

text.p: The French government is considering selling a bigger than expected stake in France Telecom in May to take advantage of good stock market conditions, financial daily Les Echos said on Wednesday.
It said it could sell between 25 and 35 percent of the telecommunications company, compared to a 20 to 25 percent stake initially planned.
The sale would raise 35 billion to 45 billion francs -- money needed by the government to pay for capital injections into other state-owned companies.
Finance ministry officials were not available for comment on the newspaper report.

The sale process would begin next week with the presentation of France Telecom accounts to stock analysts. The shares would be sold simultaneously in Paris and New York, so U.S. rules would determine the timetable for the sale, the paper said.
Bookbuilding for institutional buyers and pre-marketing for retail investors would start around May 12 and the sale would take place some 10 days later.
